name: recipe-card
title: Recipe costing card
for_each: select id,name from recipes order by name

sections.title: Ingredients
sections.sql: select i.name,i.unit,l.net_qty,l.yield_pct,i.unit_cost,i.allergen_notes from recipe_lines l join items i on i.id=l.item_id where l.recipe_id=$1
sections.note: Allergen notes are entered by the operator and are not a verified allergen declaration.

name: stocktake-sheet
title: Stocktake worksheet
for_each: select id,name from sites order by name

sections.title: Count in the listed base unit
sections.sql: select name,unit,'' as counted_quantity,'' as counted_at,'' as operator from items where site_id=$1 order by name

name: purchase-order
title: DRAFT purchase order
for_each: select id,name from orders order by name

sections.title: Order record
sections.sql: select o.name,s.name as site,s.currency,p.name as supplier,p.address,i.name as item,i.unit,o.packs,o.pack_size,o.unit_cost,o.due_on,o.state from orders o join items i on i.id=o.item_id join sites s on s.id=i.site_id join suppliers p on p.id=i.supplier_id where o.id=$1
sections.note: Review before sending. This tool does not place orders.

name: waste-register
title: Waste register
for_each: select id,name from sites order by name

sections.title: Recorded waste
sections.sql: select i.name,i.unit,m.quantity,m.unit_cost,m.reason,m.operator,m.occurred_at from movements m join items i on i.id=m.item_id where i.site_id=$1 and m.kind='waste' order by m.occurred_at

name: receiving-register
title: Receiving register
for_each: select id,name from sites order by name

sections.title: Supplier and batch trail
sections.sql: select p.name as supplier,p.address,i.name as item,m.batch,m.quantity,i.unit,m.occurred_at,m.temperature_c,m.frozen_hard,m.disposition,m.operator,m.method_ref from movements m join items i on i.id=m.item_id join suppliers p on p.id=i.supplier_id where i.site_id=$1 and m.kind='receipt' order by m.occurred_at
